observations: Photo 0 shows a red and black motorcycle with a scrambler-style design, gold front forks, and a single rearview mirror. The bike is parked on gravel, with a silver motorcycle partially visible behind it.

Photo 1 shows the front view of the same motorcycle, with a round headlight, gold forks, black front fender, and a visible 'Triumph' logo on the fuel tank. The front tire has 'SUNTRAK' visible on the sidewall.

Photo 2 shows the side profile of the motorcycle, with a black seat, black fender, and a white circular badge on the side. The front tire has 'SUNTRAK' visible again. The bike is on a kickstand, with a gravel ground and cars in the background.
The motorcycle has a retro-modern scrambler aesthetic with a high handlebar, low-slung frame, and a single rearview mirror.
No visible damage or wear is apparent in the photos, but the tires appear used with some tread wear.
The seller claims it is a '2024 Triumph motorcycle scrambler 400 x'.

claims.evidence: The year 2024 is not visible on the motorcycle in any photo. The 'Triumph' brand is visible on the fuel tank in photo 1 and 2, but the model name '400 x' is not readable. The year cannot be confirmed from the photos.

The motorcycle appears clean in the photos, but close-up shots of the engine, exhaust, and body panels are missing to confirm no dirt, oil, or grime. The condition is subjective and not fully verifiable.

risks.risk: The motorcycle may not be a 2024 model as claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine or frame with visible model year stamp or VIN plate.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used 2023 or older model, which is lower than a 2024 model.

risks.risk: The motorcycle may have mechanical issues or be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the engine starting, running, and the bike being ridden or tested.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which significantly reduces value.

risks.risk: The motorcycle may have hidden damage or wear not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the engine, exhaust, suspension, and frame for cracks, rust, or wear.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at a discount for potential hidden damage.

proof_requests: Close-up of the VIN plate or engine number to confirm the model and year.
A video of the motorcycle starting and running.
Close-up photos of the engine, exhaust, and frame for damage or wear.
A clear photo of the model name '400 x' on the fuel tank or frame.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
